title: Consecutive Login Streaks
description: Find all users who logged in on at least 3 consecutive days. Return the distinct user_id.
solutionQuery: WITH DistinctLogins AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, login_date FROM UserLogin), LeadLogins AS (SELECT user_id, login_date, LEAD(login_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY login_date ASC) AS next_day, LEAD(login_date, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY login_date ASC) AS next_next_day FROM DistinctLogins) SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM LeadLogins WHERE next_day = date(login_date, '+1 day') AND next_next_day = date(login_date, '+2 day');
explanation: Use LEAD to get the subsequent two login dates for each user and compare with date() function to verify they are consecutive.
